title: Murder
text_summary: Defines murder as the unlawful killing of a human being, or a fetus, with malice aforethought.

elements.description: The defendant committed an act that caused the death of another person (or a fetus).
The defendant acted with malice aforethought, either express (intent to kill) or implied (conscious disregard for human life).
The killing was unlawful, i.e., not justified, excused, or reduced to a lesser offense.
